dedupe_keys.name: npro online planning and simulation tool for heat networks and district energy hubs commercial

description: nPro is a commercial browser-based tool for designing and simulating heat networks and energy hubs for buildings and districts, with economics and scenario comparison. For heat networks it covers hot, low-exergy and cold networks, meshed networks and several feed-in points, with routing, pipe sizing, pressure losses and heat losses computed across the year following DIN EN 13941. Buildings get hourly heating, cooling and electricity demand for 8,760 hours from type, age and use. Energy hub design optimises heat pumps, boilers, CHP, PV and storage together, including solar thermal and PVT to ISO 9806, borehole sizing, seasonal storage and dynamic electricity prices; each scenario returns capital and operating costs, levelised cost of heat and a CO2 balance, with net present value to VDI 2067 and reports in Word or PDF, including a BEW-compliant export for German funding. Buildings and routes can be imported from Excel, CSV, GeoJSON, Shapefile, GeoPackage and Stanet files with freely named fields. Access is online in the browser under paid user licences, with quotes or direct orders; prices are not listed on the pricing page read. Coverage is any district. Caveats: proprietary models with results validated by the vendor. Simulation uses are early design and feasibility of district heating and cooling networks and supply plants for heat planning. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
